The plague now sits in 2026 as well. Across five weeks it has been placed in fall 2027, in November or December of an unspecified year, in 2027 and 2028, and now in 2026. All the tellings stay.

Three days here against two in the existing claim. Small, but it is a magnitude disagreement in the one part of the claim that is precise, so it goes in as a contradiction rather than an elaboration.
A neat piece of construction: the shaking is the mechanism of the waking, so hardship is confirmation and calm is the waking already arrived.

He stops to ask for help not misquoting it, which is worth noting: the care is about the wording, not about what follows from it. The Daniel 5 phrase implies judgment and he leaves the judgment unstated.
Set in stone is the strongest certainty language in the corpus and it is attached here to the least specific content: an unnamed figure, a cloak, a number and a year.

Third telling since 22 November and still no date. The escalation in the region is offered as the reason for repeating it.
The pattern this claim exists to record: a number arrives without a referent and the referent is found afterwards. He says plainly that he did not know what the seven meant at the time.

The most measurable claim in the batch. Record highs in metals and a sharp crypto rally inside 2026 can be checked to the dollar, unlike almost everything around it. It also overlaps gold-10k and silver-75, which carry numbers; linked by system edges.
Sits against metals-and-crypto-2026 and supernatural-increase-2026 from the same session: the economy is in trouble and there is also a windfall. Both stay; a system edge notes the tension.
Internal to the ministry and unverifiable from outside, but it is part of the account of how release timing is decided.

The 2023 word again, now attached to 2026.
He is asking what it means, not saying. Recorded as an image with no interpretation, so that if a reading is supplied later it can be compared with this.
